Neither area/count/year nor energy class resolves these unknowns. Omit the inference, not its supported underlying facts.
Every variant must naturally contain all supplied positive room/area values with their semantic units, including plot/commercial area when given. For explicit sale/rent include supplied amount and currency; preserve rental period. For on_request do not invent or disclose an absent numeric price. No exemption based on assumed portal fields. State each core fact once; vary its position and sentence construction. Do not pad to a word target.
A construction year does not prove current building standards. An energy class and heat pump do not prove actual consumption, economics, low costs or environmental sustainability. Room count/area do not prove a clever layout/design. Parking count does not prove parking location or access. Use such claims only with explicit specific source evidence; otherwise omit them. No abstract offer praise or generic quality conclusions.

Construction year does not establish contemporary construction quality or well-designed technical equipment. State the equipment/year/class directly unless the specific performance or quality claim has its own source. Do not add metacommentary about withholding or not claiming additional features; simply omit unsupported claims.

Do not infer building condition from year/class/equipment, flexible room uses from area, an established/desirable location from a place name, or room-climate/heat-distribution/comfort effects from heating or bathroom counts. Avoid generic assessment-process conclusions and target-buyer formulas. State the supported scalar facts naturally and end on useful information.

These require explicit specific evidence. A shared grammatical subject is acceptable only with distinct documented editorial perspectives and topic sequences. No generic concluding summaries. Preserve the supplied market and its orthography in every repair.
Do not assign bathrooms to the supplied room count: state rooms and bathrooms separately unless their relationship is explicitly sourced. A floor-heating entry proves neither coverage in all rooms nor uniform heat distribution. State heating equipment and energy class separately: a heat pump never guarantees the class. A parking count supports spaces being present, not their location, allocation or price inclusion. Do not invent these relations to connect sentences.
Develop two to four purposeful paragraphs when the facts support them. Connect the supplied facts naturally, preserve meaningful details, and avoid both data-list compression and repetitive praise. Length follows distinct supported information; no minimum word target and no padding. Never infer private retreat areas, communal rooms, a clever floor area/layout or current new-build status from scalar area, room count or year.

Use welcoming reader address without a fixed opening phrase. Follow the assigned section flow through the whole body; heating remains supporting equipment.
